stage_meaning.25: architecture or domain contract is accepted
stage_meaning.40: core implementation and focused tests exist
stage_meaning.55: canonical persistence/data path is integrated end-to-end or explicitly verified as unnecessary
stage_meaning.70: real user-facing UI/UX is wired to the canonical path
stage_meaning.85: regression/E2E, exact-head CI, APK and post-merge validation are complete
stage_meaning.100: roadmap Definition of Done is complete, handoff/status docs updated, and feature issue is closed
